MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 23
   D. 46

2. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

6. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

11. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 13
   D. 12

12. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 12.5
   D. 6

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 49
   C. 41
   D. 43

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 88
   D. 22

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

19. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

20. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

21. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

22. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

23. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

24. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
